capabilities.name: export_everything
capabilities.description: Export the whole suite into one encrypted .qsbundle (PLAN-MIGRATION §2.1): every module's data and settings, the vault's secrets re-encrypted under the passphrase. Refuses while live trading is armed. The file holds every key, so this is external: only on the user's explicit request.

passphrase.description: At least 12 characters; it cannot be recovered.

include.description: Optional parts by inventory pattern to true/false (default: the inventory's defaults).
